notes.title: [Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA November 8th Patch Notes]
notes.content:
[Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA] We sincerely thank our customers for their support.

On November 8th, an additional patch was applied from yesterday to fix the bugs identified below.

- The problem that the [Mir] area did not open even after completing the last quest of each unit has been fixed.
- The problem that the installation location is not stored properly has been fixed when the worn items such as consumable items mounted on the belt are changed in large quantities.

In addition, if you have any inconvenience while using the game,
Compress the [dump] folder and the [mwsSA_log.txt] file in the installed path.
Please send it through customer support.

We will do our best to respond more quickly.
[mw_sa_support@logickorea.co.kr]
Thank you.

notes.title: [Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA November 7th Patch Note]
notes.content:
Thank you for playing [Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA].

On November 7th, a patch was applied to fix the bugs below.

 - The problem that the [Moving Forest Path] hunting ground related to the Black Magician's main quest [Eerie Collection] was not displayed has been fixed.

 - In addition, if you find an abnormality, compress the [dump] folder and the [mwsSA_log.txt] file in the installed path and send it to the customer support email.
It is very helpful in identifying and correcting the cause more quickly.

If you request additional support or have a problem during the game, please contact the customer support email below.
[mw_sa_support@logickorea.co.kr]

thank you!

notes.title: [Mirror War - Holy Resurrection SA September 21st Patch Note]
notes.content:
First of all, I sincerely thank you for playing [Mirror War - Reincarnation of Holiness SA] with your long affection and interest.

We have received various issues and suggestions since our service started on September 9, and some of the confirmed contents have been modified and improved.

We will do our best to satisfy your expectations.


1. To support various training, the skill initialization cost has been changed to 0 gold, and no item is required.

2. Fixed an issue that could not be used like storing goods in an empty space in the warehouse.

3. Fixed a problem where an error window appears when trying to repair the equipment and returning to the character screen.

4. With the release of the [Powerstone] attached to the equipment, the game was forcibly terminated.

5. Fixed an abnormal display of some Japanese text.

6. For smooth feedback, create a dump file in the path where the game is installed if you encounter problems running the game.
: Compress the dump folder and mws when calling customer support. When sending SA_log.If you send me the txt file by e-mail, I can give you a more accurate answer, so please cooperate.

notes.title: [Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA User Generated Content Policy Guide]
notes.content:
Hello, this Reincarnation of Holiness SA

With an Official release of [Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA], we would like briefly provide our guidelines on the [User Generated Content] which includes game video, (Publishing video, Streaming), Music, and image.
This guideline is intended to support the creative and active use of [Mirror War - Holy Resurrection SA] by guiding the rights, obligations, and other necessary matters of the company and users regarding [User Generated Content].

We are deeply grateful to the creators and we would like to acknowledge that we strongly recommend content creation within the boundary of our [User Generated Content Guide] with the agreement to [Requirements to be followed when creating user content].


[b][The Scope of User Generated Content][/b]

When creating content that is not clearly included in the following or E-Sports, business model, please contact the customer support center and explain in detail, and discuss in advance through the customer support e-mail beforehand. 
Customer Support Center: mw_sa_support@logickorea.co.kr

1. Publish and stream gameplay videos via video platforms Ex) YouTube and Twitch.
2. Creating and sharing the game content image by using game screenshots.
3. Information sharing and discussion through the creation of pages on community sites, forums, and blogs


[b][Terms of Compliance for User Generated Content][/b]

[L&K Co., Ltd.] may request that the production be taken down in case of violating the following rules, If it is determined to be a serious violation, you may be held liable.

1. In accordance with the End User License Agreement (EULA), you must endeavor to comply with the intellectual property rights held by [L&K Co., Ltd.] (The Company).
3. You must be careful not to infringe the intellectual property rights of third parties, and you agree to indemnify the company (and its employees) in case of infringement/legal disputes and to assume all responsibilities of the creator.
2. The produced content must be used for non-commercial purposes and you cannot receive compensation for transferring it to others.
 However, it is permissive to obtain indirect advertising revenue, subscription benefits, and premium benefits through the revenue system of the platform which allows viewing the video contents for free.
3. To prevent possible confusion, you must actively indicating that the content produced is not officially produced by the developer.
4. Produced content must comply with the laws of the country in which the creator resides, content must be used by all ages, and must not violate the public order and moral.
 Furthermore, you must carefully check that the content does not contain any discrimination, hate-provoking, objectionable, direct or indirect harm, or defamation.
5. It should not be created for the purpose of maliciously falsifying, inducing negative reactions, or spoilers which most fans and gamers hate
6. When [L&K Co., Ltd.] introduces your channel or [Mirror War - Divine Resurrection SA], you must agree that [L&K Co., Ltd.] is allowed to use, modify, and edit the produced content at any time only if the creator's copyright is indicated.


Please be advised
Thank You

notes.title: "Mirror War-Reincarnation of Holiness SA" has been released.
notes.content:
Hello. Welcome to the Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA

Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA is a shooting RPG game based on an original scenario depicting the main character fighting a thrilling battle to end the 160-year-old war for hegemony on the Farrow Hill continent. 
"Mirror War-Reincarnation of Holiness SA" has been released.

[Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA] is a 3D Arcade Shooting game with a unique concept and marvelous scenario based on the original novel and all battles are developed as 3D Arcade Shooting.

Adventurers can acquire different skills and job advanced skills for each of the 12 characters and they can also strengthen by upgrading the equipment.

If you are interested in our game, or if you have already purchased our games, come and join the steam community hub to share your in-game experience and content with other players.

Steam Community Hub: Community Hub (Link https://steamcommunity.com/app/1982620)
(Mirror War: Reincarnation of Holiness SA was developed based on Korean and it also supports Japanese.)

Thank you.
